title: Lost in Implicit Routing: How LLM Agents Fail to Load Relevant Skills at Scale
title_zh: 迷失在隐式路由中：大型语言模型智能体为何在大规模场景下无法加载相关技能

paragraphs.en: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse : agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task execution. We also evaluate explicit preselection as a practical mitigation, including its coverage and latency trade-offs. Our analysis informs skill protocols and evaluation for agents with growing skill libraries. 1 1 1 Code: https://github.com/jinlinll/lost-in-implicit-routing .
paragraphs.zh: 可重复使用的技能允许 LLM 智能体按需加载特定任务的指令，但这也使得执行过程依赖于对技能元数据的隐式路由。 我们通过固定 SkillsBench 任务及其黄金技能，同时添加无关技能，来测试这种设计是否具有可扩展性。 我们发现技能路由出现了崩溃现象：智能体加载的技能数量越来越少，甚至完全不加载，尽管相关技能仍然可用。 当加入 1,000 个无关技能时，已加载技能的召回率从 73.6% 下降至 27.4%，而零加载率则从 9.3% 上升至 51.6%；相比之下，从同一技能库中进行显式选择仍能保持 73.9% 的召回率。 加载其他技能（包括与黄金技能看似合理的替代方案）的情况过于罕见，无法解释这种下降趋势。 仅对无关技能的描述进行遮蔽，基本恢复了技能的正常加载；然而，在元数据保持不变的情况下，即使明确要求智能体规划技能使用，其召回率仍低于预先选择的结果。 这些发现表明，技能的描述可能引发语义干扰，而当技能选择与任务执行发生冲突时，还会出现指令干扰。 我们还评估了显式预选择作为一种实用的缓解方法，包括其覆盖范围与延迟之间的权衡。 我们的分析为拥有不断增长的技能库的智能体提供了技能协议和评估的参考。1 1 1 代码：https://github.com/jinlinll/lost-in-implicit-routing .

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents now operate tools and files to complete multi-step workflows in software engineering, data analysis, document processing, and personal assistance ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: We use skills to mean Anthropic’s Agent Skills, whose progressive-disclosure design works as follows: the model first sees only skill names and descriptions, and opens a full skill file only if it judges the skill relevant ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . Routing is thus not a separate stage: the agent decides whether and which skills to load while planning actions, inspecting files, and solving the task. We call this execution-time selection implicit routing . It keeps long skill files out of context, but assumes that an agent can pick out the few relevant skills from many descriptions while simultaneously solving the task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“技能”定义为 Anthropic 的“智能体技能”，其渐进式披露设计如下：模型最初只能看到技能名称和描述，只有在判断某项技能相关时，才会打开完整的技能文件（Anthropic, 2026）。 因此，路由并非一个独立的阶段：智能体在规划行动、检查文件和完成任务的过程中，会决定是否需要加载技能以及加载哪些技能。 我们将这种执行时的选择称为“隐式路由”。 这种方式将较长的技能文件排除在上下文之外，但假设智能体能够在解决任务的同时，从众多描述中筛选出少数相关的技能。

paragraphs.en: We test this assumption on SkillsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) , which provides fixed task instructions, workspaces, verifiers, and relevant skills; for each task, we keep these fixed and vary only the number of added irrelevant skills. The result is skill routing collapse : the right skills are installed, but agents increasingly load fewer skills or none at all. As irrelevant skills grow from 0 to 1,000, loaded-skill recall under implicit routing drops from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%. Agents occasionally load non-golden alternatives, but too rarely to explain the collapse. Yet the same models retain 73.9% selected-skill recall when asked only to choose skills from the full library. Relevant skills thus remain recognizable; they are lost when routing becomes a subtask of execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 SkillsBench（Li et al., 2026）上测试了这一假设，该基准提供了固定的任务说明、工作区、验证器和相关技能；对于每个任务，我们保持这些要素不变，仅改变所添加的无关技能的数量。 其结果是技能路由崩溃：正确的技能虽然被安装，但智能体加载的技能数量却越来越少，甚至完全不加载任何技能。 随着无关技能数量从 0 增长到 1,000，在隐式路由下已加载技能的召回率从 73.6% 下降至 27.4%，而零加载率则从 9.3% 上升至 51.6%。 智能体偶尔会加载非黄金标准的替代技能，但这种情况发生得太少，无法解释这种崩溃现象。 然而，当仅被要求从完整技能库中选择技能时，这些模型仍能保持 73.9% 的所选技能召回率。 因此，相关技能本身仍然是可识别的；但当路由成为执行的一个子任务时，它们便无法被有效利用。

paragraphs.en: We use explicit routing in two ways. In routing-only diagnosis , the selector sees the task and the full library, including the same distractors as the executor, but only selects skills; selected-skill recall thus tests whether the needed skills are recognizable without task execution. In preselection-plus-execution , the executor then sees only the selected subset; loaded-skill recall and task success measure the practical benefit. The diagnosis changes only the objective, whereas the mitigation also narrows the executor’s library.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows implicit routing for the three open-weight models. Implicit routing collapses as irrelevant skills grow. With only 100 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall already falls by 24.6, 15.6, and 20.7 points for GLM-5, Kimi K2.5, and MiniMax M2.5 (Table 2 ), while zero-load rates rise: agents increasingly stop using skills at all rather than merely choosing wrong ones. Task success lags behind. At the same scale, GLM-5 keeps Pass@3 almost unchanged (57.3% to 56.1%) and Kimi K2.5 stays near its baseline (52.4% to 50.6%). Strong executors can solve around missing skills, so final success alone hides a failing skill protocol. Three proprietary models on a 37-task subset show the same pressure: Claude Opus 4.6, for example, keeps Pass@3 at 62.2% with 1,000 irrelevant skills (vs. 64.9%), yet its loaded-skill recall falls from 81.3% to 30.9% (Appendix E ). The collapse is also not confined to multi-skill tasks: at 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 91.9% to 38.0% on single-skill tasks and from 58.8% to 14.8% on tasks with four or more golden skills (Appendix G ). Appendix D.1 lists all plotted values.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that from zero to 1,000 distractors, the average number of loaded skills falls from 1.72 to 0.66 and the zero-load rate rises from 9.2% to 50.8%. Could agents instead be replacing golden skills with other skills? Non-golden loading is rare (2.32% of evaluations), and only 0.95% of evaluations load a non-golden skill whose embedding cosine similarity to a missed golden skill exceeds 0.8. Such loads concentrate at s = 1000 s=1000 (7.19% and 3.79%, respectively), and the above-threshold cases are near-duplicates such as pdf-reader for pdf or excel for xlsx . When agents do load skills, the loads are mostly correct: under implicit routing at 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill precision is still 88.6%, 87.2%, and 76.4% for the three models (Appendix F ). By construction, no distractor duplicates a golden skill. Routing collapse therefore primarily reflects under-loading, not substitution (details in Appendix I ).

paragraphs.en: Are the relevant skills intrinsically hard to recognize? Table 2 compares implicit loaded-skill recall with routing-only selected-skill recall for the same models and scales. The same LLMs still identify the needed skills when selection is explicit. At 1,000 irrelevant skills, GLM-5 loads 20.9% of golden skills but selects 82.5%, and Kimi K2.5 loads 40.5% but selects 80.7%; MiniMax M2.5 shows a smaller but still large gap (21.5% vs. 58.4%). The full metadata list thus often suffices for recognition when selection is the sole objective; the failure arises when selection is folded into reading files, planning commands, and completing the task.

paragraphs.en: Since the bottleneck lies in routing during execution, we next ask how much preselection helps when the executor sees only the selected subset. We do not propose a new routing algorithm; we compare simple preselectors to show when this design helps and what it costs.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 separates LLM input and output tokens for execution and preselection; embedding cost is excluded because it is negligible (below $1 in total). Preselection adds a routing call but can sharply shrink the execution context in large libraries. At 1,000 irrelevant skills, implicit routing consumes 1952k agent-input tokens, whereas LLM preselection spends 36k input tokens on routing and reduces agent input to 497k, for 547k in total. RAG is cheapest at 10,000 skills (469k) because it makes no LLM call, but it also performs worst at that scale (Figure 4 ). Hybrid preselection costs modestly more (547k, including 8k for preselection) and generalizes better.

paragraphs.en: A single RAG query built from the task instruction can over-focus on one part of a multi-step task and miss other required capabilities. Hybrid preselection instead has an LLM write several task-focused queries, retrieves candidates for each, and lets an LLM select from the pooled candidates. Table 6 compares this pool with single-query RAG@100 before final selection: at 10,000 irrelevant skills, it raises candidate recall from 88.2 to 91.8 and all-gold coverage from 78.0 to 86.2, so needed skills are less often missing from the pool. To merge the per-query lists, we take a fixed quota of top unseen skills from each query, which gives higher all-gold coverage at 10,000 than max-score or mean-score merging (86.2 vs. 80.5 and 78.2; Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 仅基于任务说明构建的单个 RAG 查询可能会过度关注多步骤任务中的某一部分，而忽略其他所需能力。 相比之下，混合预选择方法会由 LLM 生成多个聚焦于不同任务部分的查询，为每个查询检索候选项，再由 LLM 从汇总后的候选池中做出选择。 表 6 将这一候选池与最终选择前的单查询 RAG@100 进行了比较：在 10,000 个无关技能的情况下，该方法将候选项召回率从 88.2 提升至 91.8，并将全金牌覆盖率从 78.0 提升至 86.2，因此所需技能在候选池中缺失的情况更少。 为了合并各查询的列表，我们从每个查询中选取固定数量的未见过的高分技能，这种方法在 10,000 个无关技能的情况下比最大得分或平均得分合并法实现了更高的全金牌覆盖率（86.2 对比 80.5 和 78.2；附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: Fixed preselection can omit skills that become necessary later. As distractors grow from 10 to 1,000, the average number of golden skills exposed to the executor falls from 2.21 to 1.78 for LLM preselection, from 2.38 to 1.85 for RAG, and from 2.21 to 1.97 for hybrid preselection, compared with 2.52 when all golden skills are visible (Appendix J ). Coverage alone does not determine success: at 1,000, RAG exposes more golden skills than LLM preselection but reaches lower Pass@3 (46.5% vs. 51.6%), suggesting that which skills survive selection also matters. Preselection also adds latency before execution even when it saves tokens: from 10 to 1,000 distractors, the median routing time rises from 8 to 19 seconds for LLM preselection and from 33 to 41 seconds for hybrid preselection, which makes two LLM calls (Table 31 ). RAG needs no LLM call; because we embedded all skills and task instructions in a batch before the experiments, its preselection reduces to a similarity lookup, so we do not report a separate latency for it. Preselection is thus a useful mitigation rather than a complete solution, and its benefit must be weighed against coverage loss and response time.

Masked keeps every distractor slot but replaces its name, description, and location with <mask> placeholders of approximately the original length. paragraphs.en: Implicit routing suffers from instruction interference. The Plan-first prompt improves over the original condition but remains weaker than explicit preselection. To isolate the initial routing decision, Table 9 compares the skills planned in the agent’s first response with isolated LLM preselection; this planned recall is lower than final loaded recall because agents sometimes load skills absent from the initial plan. Both settings see nearly the same context, the task instruction plus the full metadata, and differ mainly in the system prompt: LLM preselection asks only for skill selection, whereas Plan-first asks the agent to solve the task and to choose skills first. paragraphs.en: These results suggest a link between the two forms of interference. During execution, descriptions act as conditional sub-instructions (load this skill when its situation arises), creating a multi-instruction-following problem alongside the task. In routing-only selection, they are instead semantic-matching inputs rather than instructions to monitor. This role shift helps explain why agents select skills more reliably when selection is their sole objective, even with the full library visible.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，这两种干扰形式之间存在关联。 在执行过程中，描述充当条件子指令（当特定情况出现时加载此技能），从而在任务之外产生一个多指令跟随问题。 在仅进行路径选择的场景中，它们反而成为语义匹配输入，而非需要监控的指令。 这种角色转变有助于解释为何当选择是智能体的唯一目标时，即使整个技能库完全可见，它们也能更可靠地选择技能。

paragraphs.en: A prompt nudge thus does not reliably separate routing from execution; reducing the visible skill set addresses both forms of interference more directly.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，提示引导无法可靠地区分路由与执行；而缩减可见的技能集能更直接地解决这两种干扰形式。

paragraphs.en: Because irrelevant descriptions interfere with both routing and task execution, narrowing the visible skill set before execution is more reliable than strengthening prompt instructions, and the right method depends on scale. For small curated libraries, implicit routing remains usable, but systems should track which skills are selected and loaded rather than rely on task success alone. Around the hundred-skill scale, explicit preselection should become the default; direct LLM preselection is simple and strong while the full metadata list fits in context. For thousands of skills, full-list LLM preselection becomes expensive or infeasible, and hybrid preselection (retrieval for a compact candidate set, then an LLM selector) is the strongest option in our experiments, improving relevant-skill coverage while keeping the execution context small. Since fixed preselection can omit skills needed later and adds latency, deployments should also monitor coverage and response time. Prompt reminders to consider skills are a lightweight safeguard that should complement, not replace, preselection. For evaluation, benchmarks of skill-using agents should report loaded-skill recall and zero-load rate alongside task success, since Pass@3 alone can hide routing failure.
paragraphs.zh: 由于无关描述会干扰路由和任务执行，在执行前缩小可见的技能集比强化提示指令更可靠，而选择哪种正确方法则取决于技能规模。 对于经过筛选的小型技能库，隐式路由仍然可用，但系统应追踪哪些技能被选中并加载，而不是仅依赖任务成功与否。 在约一百个技能的规模下，显式预选应成为默认方式；当完整元数据列表能容纳在上下文限制内时，直接由 LLM 进行预选既简单又有效。 对于数千个技能的情况，对完整列表进行 LLM 预选会变得昂贵或不可行；在我们的实验中，混合预选（先通过检索获取紧凑的候选集，再由 LLM 选择器筛选）是最佳方案，它能在保持执行上下文较小的同时提升相关技能的覆盖度。 由于固定预选可能会遗漏后续所需的技能并增加延迟，部署系统还应监控技能覆盖度和响应时间。 提示用户考虑相关技能的提醒是一种轻量级的保障机制，应作为预选的补充，而非替代方案。 在评估时，使用技能的智能体基准测试应在报告任务成功的同时，一并报告已加载技能的召回率和零加载率，因为仅靠 Pass@3 可能会掩盖路由失败的问题。

paragraphs.en: ReAct couples reasoning with actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , Toolformer learns tool calls ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , and MRKL combines language models with external knowledge and reasoning modules ( Karpas et al., 2022 ) . As action spaces grow, Gorilla and ToolLLM study API selection and invocation over massive API sets ( Patil et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2024 ) , MetaTool evaluates whether models know when and which tools to use ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , and RAG-MCP retrieves tools to counter prompt bloat ( Gan and Sun, 2025 ) . Overlapping tool names and descriptions also cause selection ambiguity, motivating tool merging or filtering ( Liu et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 将推理与行动相结合（Yao 等，2023），Toolformer 学习工具调用（Schick 等，2023），而 MRKL 则将语言模型与外部知识和推理模块相融合（Karpas 等，2022）。 随着行动空间不断扩大，Gorilla 和 ToolLLM 研究了在海量 API 集合中选择和调用 API 的方法（Patil 等，2024；Qin 等，2024），MetaTool 评估模型是否知道何时以及使用哪些工具（Huang 等，2024），而 RAG-MCP 则通过检索工具来应对提示词冗余问题（Gan 和 Sun，2025）。 工具名称和描述的重复也会造成选择上的模糊性，因此催生了工具合并或过滤的方法（Liu 等，2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Skills are more general than callable tools: they may package scripts or command-line workflows, but may also contain only background knowledge, constraints, procedures, or examples ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . They also enter context differently. Tools are typically exposed through callable interfaces and argument schemas ( Aizawa, 2025 ) , whereas skills use progressive disclosure: the agent first sees compact metadata, and full instructions, script arguments, or implementation details become visible only after loading ( Anthropic, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) . The loading decision must therefore be made from metadata alone.
paragraphs.zh: 技能比可调用工具更具通用性：它们可能封装了脚本或命令行工作流程，但也可能仅包含背景知识、约束条件、流程或示例（Zhang 等人，2025）。 它们的上下文引入方式也存在差异。 工具通常通过可调用接口和参数模式暴露出来（Aizawa，2025），而技能则采用渐进式披露机制：智能体首先看到的是简洁的元数据，完整的说明、脚本参数或实现细节只有在加载后才会显现（Anthropic，2025；Anthropic，2026）。 因此，加载决策必须仅基于元数据做出。

paragraphs.en: Voyager writes and retrieves executable code skills in Minecraft ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , Reflexion stores verbal feedback ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) , and ExpeL extracts natural-language lessons from prior experience ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . More recently, ReUseIt synthesizes reusable web workflows ( Liu et al., 2025b ) , SkillWeaver discovers and refines web-agent skills ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and SkillRL distills trajectories into hierarchical skill banks for reinforcement learning ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . These works focus on acquiring skills; we assume an existing library and ask whether agents can still route to the right skills as it grows.

paragraphs.en: We documented skill routing collapse: as libraries grow, agents increasingly load fewer or no skills even though the relevant skills remain available, and loading other skills instead is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only irrelevant descriptions largely restores skill loading, whereas explicitly planning skill use with the metadata intact remains less effective than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task completion. Preselection can stabilize skill use but introduces coverage and latency trade-offs. Growing skill libraries therefore call for explicit routing and for evaluating skill use, not task success alone. A natural next step is routing that revisits the selected subset during execution, recovering skills that fixed preselection omits without exposing the full library.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录了技能路由的崩溃现象：随着技能库的增长，智能体加载的技能越来越少，甚至完全不加载，尽管相关技能仍然可用；而加载其他技能的情况则过于罕见，无法解释这种下降趋势。 仅屏蔽无关描述在很大程度上恢复了技能的加载，但保留元数据并显式规划技能使用的效果仍不如预选择有效。 这些发现表明，当技能选择与任务完成发生冲突时，描述会引发语义干扰，而指令则会引发指令干扰。 预选择可以稳定技能使用，但也会带来覆盖范围和延迟之间的权衡问题。 因此，不断增长的技能库需要显式的路由机制以及对技能使用的评估，而不仅仅是评估任务成功与否。 一个自然的下一步是实施一种在执行过程中会重新审视已选子集的路由方式，从而在不暴露整个技能库的前提下，恢复固定预选择所遗漏的技能。

paragraphs.en: Field-level masking uses a small subset and fewer repetitions than full masking, so numerical proximity between conditions does not establish equivalence. paragraphs.en: SkillsBench is a benchmark for evaluating how agent skills affect LLM-agent task solving ( Li et al., 2026 ) . The original paper describes a community-driven construction process in which 105 contributors submitted 322 candidate tasks, followed by automated checks and human review. It states that the benchmark contains 86 tasks, excludes two GPU-dependent tasks from evaluation, and evaluates 84 tasks across 11 domains. Each task is a self-contained module with a human-written instruction, a containerized environment, a reference solution, deterministic verifier scripts, and one or more curated golden skills.

paragraphs.en: The comparison across these tables shows the masking effect discussed in the main text. paragraphs.en: However, Table 22 makes the routing degradation clearer. paragraphs.en: The table supports the same interpretation as the main text while adding a task-demand perspective. At 1,000 irrelevant skills, Naive exposure drops for both single-skill and multi-skill groups, showing that routing collapse is not limited to the hardest tasks. Loaded-skill recall shows the mechanism more directly: with 1,000 irrelevant skills, Naive exposure loads far fewer golden skills than the explicit-routing strategies across all three demand bins. Multi-skill tasks nevertheless make the mechanism more consequential: partial retrieval can find one useful skill but still miss another workflow needed for a passing solution. This is why the paper emphasizes all-gold coverage, loaded-skill recall, and trace analysis in addition to Pass@3.
paragraphs.zh: 该表与正文支持相同的解释，同时增加了对任务需求的视角。 当无关技能数量达到 1,000 个时，Naive 方法在单技能和多技能组中的暴露度均下降，表明路由崩溃现象并不仅限于最困难的任务。 已加载技能的回忆机制能更直接地展示这一现象：在 1,000 个无关技能的情况下，Naive 方法在所有三种需求区间中加载的黄金技能数量都远少于显式路由策略。 然而，多技能任务使这种机制的影响更为显著：部分检索可能找到一个有用的技能，但仍可能遗漏完成任务方案所需的另一个工作流程。 正因如此，本文除了 Pass@3 之外，还强调了全黄金覆盖、已加载技能的回忆以及轨迹分析。

paragraphs.en: Using multiple queries raises a design question: how should the retrieved lists be merged into one candidate pool? Table 27 compares three intuitive aggregators. Max keeps the best similarity score that any query gives a skill. Mean averages scores across queries. Quota takes a fixed number of top unseen skills from each query, encouraging coverage of different sub-procedures. Quota is the default in this paper, and Algorithm 2 in Appendix K gives the corresponding procedure. Quota gives the strongest all-gold coverage at 10,000 irrelevant skills, which is important for multi-skill tasks where missing one required workflow can break execution.
paragraphs.zh: 使用多个查询会引发一个设计问题：如何将检索到的列表合并为一个候选池？ 表 27 比较了三种直观的聚合方法。 Max 保留任何查询对某个技能给出的最佳相似性得分。 Mean 对各个查询的得分进行平均。 Quota 从每个查询中选取固定数量的未见过顶技能，从而鼓励覆盖不同的子流程。 Quota 是本文采用的默认方法，附录 K 中的算法 2 给出了相应的实现步骤。 在 10,000 个无关技能的情况下，Quota 实现了最强的全黄金覆盖，这对于多技能任务尤为重要，因为缺少一个必要的工作流程就可能导致执行失败。

paragraphs.en: Preselection reduces the executor’s visible library but can remove a skill that becomes relevant later. Table 30 reports the average number of golden skills exposed to the executor, computed from the intersection of the selected set with task golden skills and averaged over task–model identities. Reduced coverage limits task success because omitted skills are unavailable during execution, although success also depends on which skills are missed and the quality of the remaining set. For example, RAG can retain more golden skills than LLM preselection yet yield lower task success; aggregate coverage alone does not determine whether the most consequential skills survive selection.

paragraphs.en: We measure routing-stage latency on the adopted main-study tasks with the three open-weight models across all three runs. Routing-stage latency is the time from the start of preselection until the selected metadata is passed to the executor. For hybrid preselection, it covers query generation, query embedding and retrieval, and final LLM selection, but not the one-time construction of the skill embedding index. Environment setup, task execution, and verification are excluded.

paragraphs.en: The median delay increases from 8 to 19 seconds for LLM preselection and from 33 to 41 seconds for Hybrid as distractors grow from 10 to 1,000. Hybrid preselection makes two LLM calls (query generation and final selection), whereas LLM preselection makes one. Because the two methods were run at different times, these numbers reflect the API serving conditions of each period and are not a controlled latency comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 随着干扰项数量从 10 增加到 1,000，LLM 预选择的延迟中位数从 8 秒增加到 19 秒，而混合方法的延迟中位数则从 33 秒增加到 41 秒。 混合预选择需要两次 LLM 调用（一次用于生成查询，一次用于最终选择），而 LLM 预选择仅需一次。 由于这两种方法是在不同时间运行的，因此这些数值反映了各自运行期间的 API 服务状况，并非受控环境下的延迟对比。

paragraphs.en: We do not report routing latency for RAG. It makes no generative selector call, and we embedded all skill metadata and task instructions in a single batch before running the experiments, so RAG preselection at run time reduces to a similarity lookup over precomputed vectors. Embedding calls are typically fast relative to LLM generation, but in a deployment that embeds each new task online, this step would add a small cost that our setup does not capture. Likewise, token savings need not translate into shorter end-to-end wall time, which also depends on task behavior, API latency, and environment operations. Practical deployments should weigh coverage and task success against the added routing delay, especially for interactive tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不报告 RAG 的路由延迟。 它不会调用任何生成式选择器，并且在运行实验之前，我们将所有技能元数据和任务指令嵌入到一个批次中，因此运行时 RAG 的预选择简化为对预计算向量的相似度查找。 与 LLM 生成相比，嵌入调用通常很快，但在需要在线嵌入每个新任务的部署环境中，这一步会增加少量成本，而我们的设置并未将其纳入考量。 同样，令牌节省并不一定意味着端到端的实际运行时间会缩短，因为运行时间还取决于任务行为、API 延迟和环境操作。 在实际部署中，应权衡覆盖范围和任务成功性与额外引入的路由延迟之间的关系，尤其是在交互式任务中。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 3 lists the three baseline preselection snippets. The Naive snippet returns the whole installed skill set. paragraphs.en: The heatmaps are sorted by the Naive drop from no irrelevant skills to 1,000 irrelevant skills, so collapses under implicit routing appear near the top. This ordering makes the aggregate result more concrete: some tasks remain stable, but many tasks show abrupt failures once the library reaches hundreds or thousands of irrelevant skills. The explicit-routing heatmaps then show whether those same rows become more stable when the execution agent sees a smaller selected skill set.
paragraphs.zh: 热图按照从没有无关技能到拥有 1,000 个无关技能的“朴素”下降顺序进行排序，因此隐式路由下的崩溃情况会出现在顶部附近。 这种排序使汇总结果更加具体：一些任务保持稳定，但许多任务在技能库达到数百或数千个无关技能时会出现突然失败。 显式路由热图则显示，当执行智能体看到较小的精选技能集时，这些相同的行是否变得更加稳定。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows the most direct form of routing collapse: rows that are blue or light blue at small scale often turn light red or red as irrelevant skills are added. Figure 7 shows the complementary result from the main text: when the full metadata list still fits, explicit LLM preselection keeps many of those rows more stable. Figures 8 and 9 focus on the scalable retrieval-based setting. RAG remains feasible at 10,000 skills but produces more mixed task-level outcomes; hybrid preselection reduces some of this variance by constructing a more diverse candidate pool before final selection.
paragraphs.zh: 图6展示了路由崩溃最直接的形式：在小规模下呈蓝色或浅蓝色的行，随着无关技能的增加，通常会变成浅红色或红色。 图7展示了正文中提到的互补性结果：当完整的元数据列表仍然可以容纳时，显式的LLM预选择能保持其中许多行的稳定性更高。 图8和图9聚焦于可扩展的检索基设置。 RAG在10,000个技能下仍然可行，但会产生更多混合的任务级结果；混合预选择通过在最终选择前构建一个更多样化的候选池，减少了部分这种变异性。
